quest.title: A Soul Set Apart
quest.description: You continue searching for "the first Field Tiller," following the information you've obtained from Barbara and the Great Wolf King of the North...
quest.rewards_formatted: Adventure EXP x650, Primogem x60, Mora x31125, Guide to Freedom x2, Guide to Resistance x2, Guide to Ballad x2, Hero's Wit x3, Mystic Enhancement Ore x6

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Dain, there you are. Did you see Master Jean?

dialogues.speaker: Dainsleif
dialogues.text: I saw her, but purposely avoided her.

dialogues.speaker: Dainsleif
dialogues.text: As both the Lionfang Knight and Acting Grand Master, she naturally would have some reservations towards me.

dialogues.speaker: Dainsleif
dialogues.text: If I'm not careful, one day I may find myself becoming the object of one of her investigations.

dialogues.speaker: Dainsleif
dialogues.text: But back to the matter at hand... I defeated some of the Abyss forces but wasn't able to gather any information. Did you have more success?

dialogues.speaker: Dainsleif
dialogues.text: I see...

dialogues.speaker: Dainsleif
dialogues.text: Well then. We can more or less figure out where the first Field Tiller ended up.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Huh? Really? Just from the Lupus Boreas story?

dialogues.speaker: Dainsleif
dialogues.text: That information combined with a more comprehensive analysis.

dialogues.speaker: Dainsleif
dialogues.text: For example, the old story you told me you heard in the Cathedral...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: "The Tyrant's Final Fury"!

dialogues.speaker: Dainsleif
dialogues.text: Exactly, the strange story told to you by that young sister, long mistaken to be a curse rained down by a deceased tyrant.

choices.text: The fireballs raining from the sky were probably missiles...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Ah, Paimon gets it! So "The Tyrant's Final Fury" was really just missiles fired from the Field Tiller after it ran from Wolvendom!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: After it was damaged in the fight with the Wolf of the North, it must have wandered into the ruins of Old Mondstadt and stayed there...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Then, whenever anyone got close — PEW, PEW, BOOM! It would fire a ton of missiles at them... Until one day, it finally broke down for good, and the fireballs stopped raining from the sky.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Back then, the people of Mondstadt hadn't seen many Ruin Guards before, so they came to interpret it as "The Tyrant's Final Fury"!

response.speaker: Dainsleif
response.text: It looks like we need to make a trip to <color=#00E1FFFF>Stormterror's Lair</color> and comb the entire area.

choices.text: No.

response.speaker: Dainsleif
response.text: Hmm. What do you mean...?

response.speaker: Player
response.text: I... I remember.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Huh? You mean...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Ohh, Paimon remembers, too! We saw that abandoned <color=#00E1FFFF>Ruin Guard sitting atop the tower</color> when we went there before! Can't forget something like that!

choices.text: No need.
The ancient people of Mondstadt wouldn't have seen the fireballs for what they were...
Actually, Barbara's the deaconess...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: They... left...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: #Oh, don't be too sad, {NICKNAME}... We'll find them again! Look on the bright side, at least we got some really useful information!

choices.text: I'm... not sad.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Really? You sure...?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: At least now, as well as The Seven, Dain is also a key part of finding your sibling too, right?

choices.text: Once we get to Inazuma, we should keep that in mind as we look for more clues.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: That's right! Um... by the way, what they said just now was all pretty confusing... Did you understand it at all?

choices.text: I pretty much got it.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Oh... well then... let's go over it again.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: #First off, that Abyss Herald called {F#your brother "Prince."}{M#your sister "Princess."}

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: #It seems like your {F#brother}{M#sister} is leading the Abyss Order, even the Abyss Herald answers to {F#him}{M#her}... Still, we don't know for sure if {F#he's}{M#she's} the highest-ranking leader in the organization.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: #Also, your {F#brother}{M#sister} said that {F#he}{M#she} wants to "engulf the thrones" and go to "war with destiny." What the heck does that mean? ...Could it be {F#he}{M#that she} wants to destroy The Seven and the seven nations?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Next thing... turns out the Abyss Order monsters are really what the people of Khaenri'ah turned into after their nation was destroyed. This story is just plain terrifying!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: And Dain is from Khaenri'ah, too! He witnessed its destruction 500 years ago. But... he didn't turn into a monster, and now he's fighting the Abyss Order...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: #So that's why {F#your brother}{M#your sister} said that Dain is {F#his}{M#her} enemy, right?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: But... If the monsters of the Abyss are the same people that Dain protected all those years ago, then why is he enemies with the Abyss Order now?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: #Also, how come... after all this time we've spent searching for {F#your brother}{M#your sister}, it turns out {F#he's}{M#she's} on the side of the Abyss. What's up with that?

choices.text: We have many new questions, but few answers.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Yeah, you're right.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: #Then... we can't let ourselves get down about it now, {NICKNAME}!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Our journey's not over yet, let's get a move on! Time to leave this terrible, dark place and get back to the surface, where the sun shines bright.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: #If your {F#brother}{M#sister} wants you to "reach the end of your journey"... {F#Show him}{M#Well then, show her} what you're made of!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Come on, Traveler, let's go!

choices.text: Thinking about it over and over will solve nothing.
#I was too focused on {F#my brother}{M#Lumine} to really listen carefully.
Another objective for our journey.
You're right, Paimon. There is hope.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Uh-huh, that's right!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: This is it, right? Okay then, use your Elemental Sight to look for the eye!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Ooooh... So what did you see?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Huh? ...Nothing? But Paimon was so excited...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: What's going on...? Are you sure you did it right?

dialogues.speaker: Dainsleif
dialogues.text: This requires another method.

dialogues.speaker: Dainsleif
dialogues.text: Using Elemental Sight on a Field Tiller is of no use because it is not powered by the elements.

dialogues.speaker: Dainsleif
dialogues.text: Let me give it a try.

dialogues.speaker: Dainsleif
dialogues.text: ...And done.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Wowwww! It's, it's the...!

dialogues.speaker: Dainsleif
dialogues.text: The very thing the Abyss Herald has been seeking all along — the eye of the first Field Tiller.

dialogues.speaker: Dainsleif
dialogues.text: All of the Ruin Guards today are just replicas of this machine. As the prototype, its combat capability was unrestricted.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: "Prototype"? ...Paimon doesn't know that word, is it another ancient term from Khaenri'ah?

dialogues.speaker: Dainsleif
dialogues.text: As the Abyss Order has surmised, if this eye is placed in the hands of the Defiled Statue...

dialogues.speaker: Dainsleif
dialogues.text: And if the limbs of Osial, Overlord of the Vortex, are attached to the statue... there you have a mechanized god.

dialogues.speaker: Dainsleif
dialogues.text: And this newly born god will have the power to "topple the divine thrones of Celestia."

choices.text: What an extreme and dangerous operation.

response.speaker: Dainsleif
response.text: Yes.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Th—Then... What should we do with this eye?

choices.text: Hide it somewhere no one will find it.

response.speaker: Dainsleif
response.text: No. I'll guard it myself.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Huh!? You!? Dain... You won't go and do anything crazy with it, will you?

response.speaker: Dainsleif
response.text: You may doubt me if you wish, but I must ensure it does not fall into the wrong hands.

response.speaker: Dainsleif
response.text: No matter where we may hide it, they will find it. And as for the Church of Favonius — well, you know I don't trust them.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Oh, hehe... right...

response.speaker: Dainsleif
response.text: But our work isn't done yet. To avoid any further repercussions, we must also take care of that Defiled Statue.

choices.text: By doing what, exactly?

response.speaker: Dainsleif
response.text: We can't have the Church get involved. Let's handle it ourselves. As for what I mean by take care of it... naturally, I mean to completely destroy it.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: D—Destroy it!? That's a Statue of The Seven! As well as being a really important cultural relic, they're actually divine, too...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Ugh, well, good thing we didn't tell Barbara earlier. Otherwise, she'd be going completely bonkers right now!

response.speaker: Dainsleif
response.text: Hmph... Do The Seven really expect me to help them look after what belongs to them?

response.speaker: Dainsleif
response.text: Let's go back to <color=#00E1FFFF>those ruins</color> and destroy the inverted statue. If we are lucky, we will also run into that Abyss Herald.

response.speaker: Dainsleif
response.text: I'll make sure it doesn't get away this time.

choices.text: Can we let the Church take care of this one?
Put it under the guardianship of the Church of Favonius.
The Abyss Order must be stopped.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Hey, c—could that be...!?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: #{F#Aether}{M#Lumine}!

dialogues.speaker: Sibling
dialogues.text: #{F#Lumine}{M#Aether}...

choices.text: I've finally found you!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: #W—Wait, {NICKNAME}... {F#He}{M#She} just blocked an attack against the Abyss Herald...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: #Your {F#brother}{M#sister}, and the Abyss...

response.speaker: Sibling
response.text: #{F#Lumine}{M#Aether}, why are you with Dain?

choices.text: ...What?

response.speaker: Player
response.text: (We've been separated for so long...)

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Huh?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: #Your {F#brother}{M#sister}... knows Dain, {NICKNAME}?

response.speaker: Dainsleif
response.text: #{F#Aether}{M#Lumine}. We meet again.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: #Wh—What's going on here? Dain knows {F#him}{M#her}, too!

response.speaker: Sibling
response.text: You shouldn't team up with this man.

response.speaker: Sibling
response.text: He is my enemy.

response.speaker: Dainsleif
response.text: #{F#Aether}{M#Lumine}...

choices.text: Hold on a second!

response.speaker: Sibling
response.text: But it must be said... Don't try to stop me. Don't try to stop the Abyss.

response.speaker: Sibling
response.text: That man, Dainsleif, was the "Twilight Sword," one of the royal guards of the final dynasty of Khaenri'ah. 500 years ago, he failed to prevent the destruction of Khaenri'ah.

response.speaker: Sibling
response.text: #A curse of immortality was laid upon him, to forever wander the wilderness... while he watched the people he was supposed to protect turn into {F#the monsters}{M#monsters} of the Abyss.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: You're saying... Dain is from Khaenri'ah!? The same Khaenri'ah that was destroyed 500 years ago!?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: And you said the people turned into monsters... You're trying to tell Paimon that the Abyss Order is not only related to Khaenri'ah but is actually the people of Khaenri'ah themselves!?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Uh... and the whole thing about Dain being your enemy? Ohh... Paimon's so confused...

choices.text: #Come with me, {F#Aether}{M#Lumine}! Let's go home!

response.speaker: Sibling
response.text: Home...

response.speaker: Sibling
response.text: Yes, of course. "Home" is wherever we are together.

response.speaker: Sibling
response.text: But I cannot go with you to the next world to find a new home... at least, not yet.

response.speaker: Sibling
response.text: Until the Abyss has engulfed the thrones, my war with destiny will see no end...

response.speaker: Player
response.text: Destiny...?

response.speaker: Sibling
response.text: #Listen to me, {F#Lumine}{M#Aether}.

response.speaker: Sibling
response.text: I have already traveled through this world once. Once you reach the end of your journey as I did, you will see for yourself the true nature of this world.

choices.text: You can tell me all this later. Let's go home!
#Stop saying things that don't make sense, {F#Aether}{M#Lumine}!
You're asking about... Dain?
Let's get out of here, it's too dangerous!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: So, after all that running around, we end up right back here again...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Look at us... We barely escaped this place last time, and now we're strolling right back in!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Gee, surely we must be some of the bravest adventurers in all of Teyvat! That or the stupidest...

dialogues.speaker: Dainsleif
dialogues.text: Looks like we're here.

dialogues.speaker: Dainsleif
dialogues.text: An eerie, lifeless, dark chamber... I understand the evil aura you were describing earlier.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Ohhhh... Such a scary place...

dialogues.speaker: Dainsleif
dialogues.text: Be careful to not be overwhelmed by the power of the Defiled Statue— the Abyss Herald, it's here.

dialogues.speaker: Abyss Herald
dialogues.text: Mwahaha... You sense correctly.

dialogues.speaker: Abyss Herald
dialogues.text: You are just as vexatious as ever, Dainsleif, enemy of the Abyss!

dialogues.speaker: Abyss Herald
dialogues.text: I sense your soul is stained by terrible bloodshed, perhaps from your darkest nightmares. Unless... Huh?

dialogues.speaker: Abyss Herald
dialogues.text: Oh, and something far more dangerous! You reek of a corruption familiar to me...

dialogues.speaker: Abyss Herald
dialogues.text: Then we are the same. We're both dangerous. But dangers from outside of the Abyss Order must be caught and caged...

dialogues.speaker: Dainsleif
dialogues.text: Tsk.

dialogues.speaker: Dainsleif
dialogues.text: It is your words that forever reek of corruption...

dialogues.speaker: Dainsleif
dialogues.text: Time to silence you!
